Overview & City Profile

Amorebieta-Etxano (Amorebieta-Etxano (Bizkaia)) is a municipality in Bizkaia, Basque Country (coordinates 43.2199°N, -2.706°E; population 18,513). Visitors use Amorebieta-Etxano as a base to explore Basque Country's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Pintxos (Gilda, txangurro, tortilla), Txuleta (charcoal-grilled ribeye), Bacalao al pil-pil.

Within Basque Country Region (Bizkaia region), Amorebieta-Etxano (Amorebieta-Etxano (Bizkaia)) serves as a municipio (municipality) in basque country region. Travelers exploring Basque Country often combine a stop in Amorebieta-Etxano with regional highlights such as San Sebastián La Concha Bay & Parte Vieja pintxo bars, Guggenheim Museum Bilbao & Casco Viejo, San Juan de Gaztelugatxe & Getaria, Vitoria-Gasteiz medieval quarter.

Getting to Amorebieta-Etxano & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Vitoria-Gasteiz Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)): Bilbao Airport (BIO) and San Sebastián; Renfe Alvia trains and Euskotren coastal line between Bilbao and Donostia.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Basque Country Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Vitoria-Gasteiz with Amorebieta-Etxano. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep €1,000 bills and €100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Basque Country have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Amorebieta-Etxano en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Amorebieta-Etxano are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail station or airport in Basque Country can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Practical Travel Tips for Amorebieta-Etxano

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Amorebieta-Etxano (or at Vitoria-Gasteiz Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Amorebieta-Etxano accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Spain Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Amorebieta-Etxano (Amorebieta-Etxano (Bizkaia)) located in Spain?

Amorebieta-Etxano (Amorebieta-Etxano (Bizkaia)) is a municipio (municipality) located in Basque Country Region in the Bizkaia region of Spain (coordinates: 43.2199°N, -2.706°E). It has a population of approximately 18,513 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Amorebieta-Etxano by train?

Most visitors reach Amorebieta-Etxano via the main prefectural gateway of Vitoria-Gasteiz Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail). Bilbao Airport (BIO) and San Sebastián; Renfe Alvia trains and Euskotren coastal line between Bilbao and Donostia. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Amorebieta-Etxano. What local food is Amorebieta-Etxano and Basque Country known for?

In Amorebieta-Etxano and across Basque Country Region, top local dishes include Pintxos (Gilda, txangurro, tortilla), Txuleta (charcoal-grilled ribeye), Bacalao al pil-pil, as well as Basque burnt cheesecake (La Viña style) and Txakoli & Rioja Alavesa wines. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.
